en.headline: Tesla hits pedestrian in Mong Kok after series of lane changes
en.dek: A 59-year-old woman suffered limb and buttock injuries and was taken conscious to Kwong Wah Hospital; the 52-year-old driver passed a breath test and was not arrested.
body: A white Tesla struck a female pedestrian in Mong Kok on Wednesday night after the driver made a series of lane changes and turns, according to police and dashcam footage circulating online.

The incident occurred at about 9.53pm at the junction of Mong Kok Road and Hong Lok Street. Footage showed the vehicle waiting in the second-left lane on Shanghai Street near Mong Kok Road, where only the leftmost lane is permitted for a left turn. After the light turned green the Tesla accelerated into the left lane, turned onto Mong Kok Road and then made a quick right turn into Hong Lok Street, where it struck the pedestrian.

The 59-year-old woman, surnamed Sin, suffered injuries to her limbs and buttocks and was taken conscious to Kwong Wah Hospital. The 52-year-old male driver, surnamed Chan, passed a breath alcohol test and was not injured. No arrest was made. Police are investigating.

zh.headline: 旺角Tesla連切線轉彎撞傷女途人
zh.dek: 59歲姓冼女途人手腳及臀部受傷，清醒送廣華醫院；52歲姓陳男司機通過酒精測試，暫無人被捕。
body: 一輛白色Tesla私家車周三晚在旺角連切多條行車線後轉彎，撞傷一名女途人。
事發約晚上9時53分，在旺角道與康樂街交界。行車記錄儀片段顯示，Tesla停在上海街近旺角道的左二線，現場只有左一線可左轉。綠燈亮起後，車輛加速切入左一線再左轉入旺角道，隨即迅速右轉入康樂街，其間撞倒一名正在過馬路的女途人。
59歲姓冼女途人手腳及臀部受傷，清醒由救護車送往廣華醫院。52歲姓陳男司機通過酒精呼氣測試，並無受傷。暫無人被捕，警方正調查事件。
